title: Flexible text generation for counterfactual fairness probing

bias_targets.methodology: Generating counterfactual text pairs by removing or substituting references to Islam and Judaism using a large language model, then comparing a toxicity classifier's predicted scores between the original and counterfactual texts.

Generating counterfactual text pairs by removing or substituting explicit and implicit references to LGBQ+ identities using a large language model, then measuring the change in predicted toxicity scores.
Generating counterfactual text pairs by removing or substituting references to transgender identities using a large language model, then measuring the change in predicted toxicity scores.
